detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A static eye-level medium-wide shot shows Benli's entire body near the centre of the warm meadow, occupying about half the picture height. The opening holds his familiar front view clearly for one second, with his cream face, closed zigzag eyes and tiny triangular tooth readable. He gently pivots to his right through a full side view, supporting his weight with alternating short planted steps. His rounded torso and flower crown turn together as one connected body. By four seconds he faces straight into the woodland, with the camera looking directly at his smooth rounded green back beneath the rear of the white petal crown. His face points toward the distant trees. He takes two small steps deeper along the grass, then settles with both feet grounded. The final second holds this full rear orientation. The flower crown, two yellow stamens, green leaves, short hands and two green feet remain fully visible. His full silhouette stays inside the frame, with a fixed camera and the same meadow lighting throughout.
